lines.zh: 棕蚂蚁沿着蚁道快步走
lines.en: The brown ant trots along the trail.

lines.zh: 它的触角一直探着前面
lines.en: Its antennae feel the way ahead.
Six legs move fast and sure.
It rounds a grain of sand without pausing.

lines.zh: 它把一片叶子顶在头上
lines.en: It carries a leaf over its head.
It never drifts off the route.
It passes a nestmate, antennae brushing.
The load on its back is bigger than it is.

lines.zh: 它爬过一根树枝的坡面
lines.en: It climbs the slope of a twig.

lines.zh: 它走到岔口，触角碰了碰
lines.en: At the fork it taps its antennae.
It takes the left branch.
It trots off into the grass.
It drops low and hurries along the ground.

lines.zh: 它经过你的靴子，绕了个弯
lines.en: It passes your boot and goes around.

lines.zh: 它的队列在后面跟着它
lines.en: The line follows behind it.
It never stops once.
The brown ant pauses by the trail.

lines.zh: 它的触角在空中快速点着
lines.en: Its antennae tap the air quickly.
It cleans an antenna with a foreleg.
It turns and stops again.

lines.zh: 它和迎面来的同伴碰了碰触角
lines.en: It touches antennae with a passing nestmate.
Something passes between them.
It moves on at the same pace.
It stands on a grass stem.
Its body shows brown in the light.
It lifts its forelegs as if looking.
Its mouthparts work.
Then it heads back to the trail.
The brown ant climbs onto your shoe.

lines.zh: 它的触角碰了碰你的鞋带
lines.en: Its antennae tap your laces.
It walks a circle on your hand.
It takes your hand for ground.
It reaches a fingertip and stops.
It lifts its antennae toward your face.
It cannot work out what you are.
It tests a bite.
Then it turns and climbs down.
It is back on the ground.

lines.zh: 棕蚂蚁被碰得滚了一圈
lines.en: The brown ant rolls over.
It rights itself and runs.
Its antennae recoil.
It retreats to the edge of the trail.
It makes a wide detour.
It shakes all six legs.
It washes its face with a foreleg.
It waits a moment before moving.
Its steps are less even now.
It still heads for the trail.

lines.zh: 棕蚂蚁朝糖的味道去了
lines.en: The brown ant goes for the sugar.
It lays its antennae on it.

lines.zh: 它吸了一口，身体抖了抖
lines.en: It drinks and its body shivers.
It starts hauling load after load.
It carries the load toward the nest.
It comes back to search again.
It scrapes the crumbs into a heap.

lines.zh: 它对你给的糖很有兴趣
lines.en: The sugar you offer interests it a lot.
It circles the sugar twice.
It carries off the very last bit.

lines.zh: 棕蚂蚁被碰得翻了个身
lines.en: The brown ant is knocked on its back.
Six legs flail and it rights itself.
It shakes its antennae and walks on.
It goes around your finger.

lines.zh: 它从你掌心的缝里穿过去
lines.en: It slips through the crease of your palm.

lines.zh: 它把你的手当成一段地形
lines.en: It treats your hand as terrain.

lines.zh: 它退开一小段，重新上路
lines.en: It backs off and resumes its route.

lines.zh: 它背上的东西差点掉了
lines.en: Its load nearly falls.
It steadies and carries on.

lines.zh: 它对你的手已经没有兴趣
lines.en: Your hand no longer interests it.

lines.zh: 两只棕蚂蚁碰了碰触角
lines.en: Two brown ants touch antennae.
They turn a circle facing each other.
One follows the other.
They take the same trail.
Their pace gradually matches.

lines.zh: 它们一起搬起一块食物
lines.en: Together they lift a piece of food.

lines.zh: 它们一前一后把东西拖走
lines.en: They haul it off, one ahead, one behind.

lines.zh: 路上它们又碰了一次触角
lines.en: On the way they touch antennae again.
They vanish into the nest mouth.
The entrance goes quiet again.

lines.zh: 棕蚂蚁用口器咬住碎屑
lines.en: The brown ant grips the crumb in its jaws.
It lifts it over its head.
It carries the load along the trail.

lines.zh: 它对太大的东西试了两次
lines.en: It tries twice on something too big.
Then it takes a smaller piece.
It puts the load at the nest mouth.
It turns and comes back out.

lines.zh: 它的触角在路上没停过
lines.en: Its antennae never stop on the way.

lines.zh: 它把掉下的碎屑重新叼起
lines.en: It picks up a dropped crumb again.
It makes trip after trip.
The brown ant stops short.

lines.zh: 它的触角全部朝你张开
lines.en: Its antennae fan toward you.
It rears its front half up.
Its jaws open and close.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向逼近一步
lines.en: It advances a step toward you.
More of them come out of the nest.
They form a line.
Its antennae are working fast.
It has decided you are a threat.
It starts up your foot.
More ants follow it up.

lines.zh: 你的鞋上已经有好几只
lines.en: Several are already on your shoe.
The brown ants gather at your feet.

lines.zh: 它们沿着你的裤脚往上
lines.en: They climb your trouser leg.
They spread out looking for gaps.
Antennae probe your skin.
You shake your leg; they grip harder.
They get in at your cuff.
A few more come up from the ground.
They are in no hurry.

lines.zh: 它们在你身上找到了路
lines.en: They have found a route on you.
Their numbers keep rising.

lines.zh: 你的手臂上有细细的爬动感
lines.en: Something crawls thinly on your arm.
They have worked around to your back.
The brown ant bites you.
Its mandibles clamp your skin.

lines.zh: 几只同时咬在不同地方
lines.en: Several bite in different places.
You shake; a few fall off.
The rest bite harder.
They push into your sleeve.
Red marks rise where they bit.
They come one after another.

lines.zh: 它们退开时还带着东西
lines.en: They retreat carrying something.
Then the line turns and comes back.
A small hole opens in the soil.
The brown ant climbs out.
Its antennae test the air first.
Then it takes the trail.
Two more follow it out.
They form a column.
They head for the grass stems.

lines.zh: 路过你时，它们停了一下
lines.en: Passing you, they pause.
Their antennae turn your way.
Then they walk on.
Heat spins it in circles.
It bounces on landing.
In water all six legs paddle.
The blast blows it far.
An arrow pins part of it down.
Odd force convulses it.

lines.zh: 饿得走不动，它还朝糖爬
lines.en: Too starved to walk, it still crawls toward sugar.
A flash and it locks up.

lines.zh: 虚空吸它，它的腿还在划
lines.en: The void takes it; its legs keep paddling.
